text:
14-Day Plan (2 Hours/Day)
Day 1 – What is an LLM?
Theory (1 hour)
What is AI?
ML vs Deep Learning vs LLM
What is an LLM?
Tokens
Context Window
Parameters
Temperature
Practical (1 hour)
Install Python environment
Install Ollama (or choose an API)
Run your first LLM locally or via API
Generate text from Python

Interview Questions

What is an LLM?
What is a token?
What is a context window?
Day 2 – How GPT Works
Theory
Transformer (high level)
Attention
Tokenization
Embeddings (overview)
Practical
Count tokens
Compare prompts
Experiment with temperature

Interview Questions

Why are Transformers better than RNNs?
What is self-attention?
Day 3 – Prompt Engineering

Learn:

Zero-shot
One-shot
Few-shot
System prompts
Structured output

Practice:

Summarizer
Email generator
JSON extraction
Day 4 – Embeddings

Theory:

What are embeddings?
Cosine similarity
Semantic search

Practical:

Generate embeddings
Compare sentence similarity

Interview:

Why not use SQL LIKE?
Why embeddings instead of keywords?
Day 5 – Vector Database

Theory:

Why vector DB?
Indexing
Top-K retrieval

Practical:

Use FAISS
Store vectors
Search vectors

Interview:

Why FAISS?
What is Top-K search?
Day 6 – RAG

Theory:

What is RAG?
Chunking
Retrieval
Prompt augmentation
Generation

Draw the full pipeline on paper.

Practical:

Load one PDF
Split into chunks

Interview:

Explain the RAG pipeline.
Day 7 – Build RAG (Part 1)

Code:

Load PDFs
Chunk
Create embeddings
Store in FAISS

End of Day:

Search documents by question
Day 8 – Build RAG (Part 2)

Connect:

Retriever
LLM
Final answer generation

You now have a working RAG application.

Day 9 – Improve RAG

Learn:

Chunk size
Chunk overlap
Metadata
Filtering
Hallucinations

Experiment with different settings.

Day 10 – LangChain

Learn:

Documents
Loaders
Splitters
Embeddings
Retrievers
Chains

Rebuild the project using LangChain.

Day 11 – Build Web UI

Backend:

FastAPI

Frontend:

Simple Streamlit or HTML

Features:

Upload PDF
Ask question
Get answer
Day 12 – Production Improvements

Add:

Multiple PDFs
Error handling
Chat history
Logging
Clean project structure
Day 13 – Resume + GitHub

Create:

README
Architecture diagram
Screenshots
Requirements
Dockerfile (if possible)

Update resume with the project.

Day 14 – Interview Day

Practice answering:

What is an LLM?
What is RAG?
Explain embeddings.
Why vector DB?
Explain cosine similarity.
What is chunking?
Why chunk overlap?
What is hallucination?
RAG vs Fine-tuning.
Why FAISS?
How does retrieval work?
How does the LLM know which document to answer from?

Also practice explaining your project end-to-end..
